summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 34 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) Roots ignores the error from policy.Load, so a malformed policy.json silently falls back to the default phase root, and operator-declared phase roots vanish with no warning. (2) In discover_test.go, TestValidateUserSpec's 'native reserved' case passes by accident: native is a valid kind, and the case passes only because the one-word name 'x' produces a violation that also contains 'reserved'. (3) TestRepoPhaseCatalog_NoInertFailIfSignal repeats the directory walk that eachTrackedPhaseClassify provides. (4) docs/architecture/phase-plugin-system.md §3.2 still describes EVOLVE_PHASE_ROOTS and cmd/evolve phaseRoots; the roots now come from paths.phase_roots in policy.json.
